projects.name: PantryPal

Integrated \textbf{Google Vision API} OCR (\textbf{90\%+} accuracy) and \textbf{Spoonacular} meal planning, eliminating manual entry; \textbf{JWT} auth with role scoping and household join codes

projects.name: MyDrive
latex_bullets: Trained an \textbf{XGBoost} accident-risk classifier on fused crash and weather data; re-weighted an \textbf{OSMnx} road graph by predicted risk and routed via \textbf{NetworkX} across \textbf{8 presets} (time, tolls, stress, safety, reliability)

Built a \textbf{FastAPI} backend with 10 endpoints serving a \textbf{Streamlit} desktop UI, mobile \textbf{PWA}, and \textbf{Expo} native shell; Folium risk heatmap and \textbf{OSRM/Mapbox} turn-by-turn
projects.summary: MyDrive (2025): Chicagoland multi-objective route planner. XGBoost accident-risk classifier on crash + weather data; OSMnx/NetworkX routing across 8 presets. FastAPI backend serving Streamlit, a mobile PWA, and Expo; Folium heatmap and OSRM/Mapbox navigation. https://github.com/rsheth8/MyDrive

projects.name: SongSift
latex_bullets: Extracted MFCCs, chroma, spectral, and tempo features via \textbf{librosa}; built \textbf{3 recommendation strategies} (content-based, collaborative filtering, hybrid) through a \textbf{Flask} REST API

Implemented \textbf{KMeans} playlist clustering, \textbf{NetworkX} similarity graph with 3 path algorithms, beat-matched mashup studio, and lyric sentiment analysis; frontend in \textbf{React + TypeScript}
projects.summary: SongSift (Dec 2025–Mar 2026): local music analysis workbench. librosa audio features; content-based, collaborative, and hybrid recommenders via Flask. KMeans playlists, NetworkX similarity graph, beat-matched mashups, lyric sentiment; React + TypeScript frontend. https://github.com/rsheth8/SongSift

projects.name: Hindsight

Server-side problem generation and grading (Financial Modeling Prep); heuristic fallback so the game still runs without API keys; Vitest + Playwright coverage
projects.summary: Hindsight (2026): Next.js + Expo daily puzzle that grades investing judgment — anonymized price windows, Brier calibration, Claude-graded reasoning, Elo-style rating with a luck filter. FMP for history; works without keys via a fallback problem bank. https://github.com/rsheth8/Hindsight

projects.name: Textbook RAG Assistant
latex_bullets: Spring Boot 3 / Java 17 app: upload a textbook PDF (Apache PDFBox), store text in \textbf{PostgreSQL}, retrieve the best-matching passage, and answer via Ollama or Open WebUI so replies stay textbook-faithful
Docker Compose + Railway deploy; pgvector/Spring AI wired for a planned embeddings upgrade (current retrieval is keyword/paragraph scoring, not vector search)
projects.summary: Textbook RAG Assistant (2025–2026): Spring Boot + Java 17. PDFBox ingestion into PostgreSQL, passage retrieval, Ollama/Open WebUI answers that stick to the book. Docker/Railway. Retrieval today is keyword/paragraph scoring; pgvector is scaffolded. https://github.com/rsheth8/Textbook_RAG_Assistant

projects.name: Bar4Bar

projects.name: Movie Sentiment Comparison
latex_bullets: Compared a frozen sentence-transformer + PyTorch MLP head (\textbf{76.8\%} test accuracy) against zero-shot \textbf{Flan-T5-small} (\textbf{84.1\%}) on Rotten Tomatoes reviews, plus a 50\% majority baseline
Broke errors down by review length and inspected FP/FN examples side-by-side so the write-up showed \emph{where} each approach fails, not just a leaderboard number
